integration_issues.issue: CollectionsDashboard.jsx called `${API}/collections/dashboard` (=> /api/collections/dashboard) instead of `${API}/super-admin/collections/dashboard`. Caused 404 and dashboard stuck on loading spinner. Fixed in this iteration.

action_items: Confirm the URL fix in CollectionsDashboard.jsx is acceptable (testing agent applied it: line 29 now uses `${API}/super-admin/collections/dashboard`).
Consider centralising the SA base URL (e.g., `SA_API = `${API}/super-admin`) to avoid similar 404 wiring bugs in future SA components.
critical_code_review_comments: CollectionsDashboard.jsx swallows fetch errors silently (`catch {}`). User sees an indefinite loader on failure. Surface a small error state / Badge so SA can tell when the endpoint is broken.
Hard-coded role labels and SEVERITY_COLORS could be moved to constants for reuse across SA dashboards.
super_admin.py:838 — `days: int = 90` is clamped (good) but doesn't reject `days<0` with 400; silently clamps to 7. Acceptable but document the behavior.
Top-offenders aggregation iterates per-row to look up company name and subscription (N+1). With 22 companies it's fine, but at scale prefer a single $lookup pipeline.

system_users.py:106 uses bare `except Exception: pass` for the email send — make sure the logger.error inside email_service still fires (it does). Consider re-logging at the route too for traceability.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: In /app/frontend/src/components/super-admin/CollectionsDashboard.jsx line 29, axios.get used `${API}/collections/dashboard` while the FastAPI router is mounted at prefix `/super-admin` (routes/super_admin.py line 13). Resulting URL was /api/collections/dashboard which is not registered → 404. UI swallowed the error and never set `data`, so the loader spinner stayed forever. FIX: prefix changed to `${API}/super-admin/collections/dashboard`. REPRO: open /admin → SA login → click Cobranza tab → before fix you see only a spinner + two 404s in console; after fix all KPIs, charts and ranking render.
